tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description starts with imperative phrasing ('Diagnose an Amazon S3 403 AccessDenied... Use this skill whenever...'), lists explicit trigger contexts (specific API calls, error message patterns, cross-account cases, KMS denials), explicitly scopes out-of-domain cases (503 SlowDown, CloudFront, Lake Formation, Bedrock/SageMaker), and remains a concise paragraph despite covering a lot of ground.
tests.evidence: Diagnose an Amazon S3 403 AccessDenied. Use this skill whenever an S3 request fails with AccessDenied or 403 Forbidden: GetObject, PutObject, ListBucket, HeadObject or CopyObject calls... Not for 503 SlowDown, replication or lifecycle issues, CloudFront 403s, Lake Formation access, Bedrock or SageMaker role denials, or a least-privilege review with no observed failure.

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body jumps straight into domain-specific procedure (ten layers of S3 authorization, verdicts, report format) without explaining general concepts like what S3 or IAM are. Every sentence conveys non-obvious, skill-specific information.
tests.evidence: S3 evaluates every layer that applies to the request. Any explicit deny wins, and the request also needs an allow.

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The body keeps detailed material (per-layer API calls, denial message hints, fallback sources) out and defers to references/ files, loaded conditionally. No large reference tables or lookup data are embedded inline.
tests.evidence: Load [references/layers.md](references/layers.md#the-ten-layers) at Step 4 for the API call that reads each layer and its typical denial.

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: Both reference files (denial-message-hints.md and layers.md) are linked via markdown links in the body.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Each reference link specifies the precise trigger condition for loading (e.g., only when a message/errorMessage exists, or when a read is blocked, or at Step 4/6, or only when all layers are clean).
tests.evidence: load it only when a message or CloudTrail `errorMessage` exists); it narrows the search.

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All reference links use relative paths from the skill root with no absolute paths or traversals.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile/consequential steps (Step 8 validation, safety read-only rules, verdict assignment) are prescriptive with exact closed-set verdicts, while flexible steps (fix proposal, report wording) allow reasoning and judgment with rationale given (e.g., why SimulatePrincipalPolicy is insufficient).
tests.evidence: `SimulatePrincipalPolicy` ignores VPC endpoint policies and session policies and only partly evaluates SCPs and RCPs. A simulation result of "allowed" is never a verdict on its own.

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: Where tool choice is discussed, a clear default/preference is stated (read policy documents first) with the alternative framed as mere corroboration, not an equal option.
tests.evidence: read each layer's document directly. Use `SimulatePrincipalPolicy` only as corroboration.

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable procedure (classify, pin request, walk ten layers, assign verdicts, propose fix) applicable to any S3 AccessDenied case, not a one-off instance.
tests.evidence: Step 5 - Walk the layers: evaluate all ten layers; do not stop at the first one that passes.

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: A dedicated Gotchas section lists concrete, non-obvious environment-specific pitfalls (blocked reads, SimulatePrincipalPolicy limitations, bucket-level vs object-level ARNs, KMS root-only policy trap).
tests.evidence: A resource ARN of `[redacted ARN]` covers bucket-level actions such as `ListBucket` only. Object actions need `[redacted ARN]`.

tests.reasoning: The skill provides an explicit, sufficiently detailed report format section inline covering all needed structured output elements.
